parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 29 in RadioPlayerMessages.swift) and `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 28 in HLSPlayerMessages.swift) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Since the implementations are identical and neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `MessageMakeable`) with a default implementation of `makeMessage()` in a protocol extension, allowing both conforming types to drop their individual implementations entirely.
